position: One portable manifest, no credentials and no endpoint
headline: The dry-run manifest is complete enough to review and too constrained to launch.
copy: The contract validates only names, boundaries, limits, and rollback posture. It never serializes a secret value or activates an endpoint.

postures.title: Runtime
postures.copy: The Web-standard request and response boundary is portable.

postures.title: Operational limits
postures.copy: Request size, timeout, rate, redaction, and rollback are bounded.

postures.title: Provider deployment
postures.copy: The reference manifest is dry-run only.

flow.title: Describe
flow.copy: Name environment, runtime, region, routes, and access.

flow.title: Reference
flow.copy: Carry managed secret names without values.

flow.title: Constrain
flow.copy: Set privacy-safe logs, request limits, and zero writes.

flow.title: Validate
flow.copy: Return a redacted summary and no deployment side effect.

decisions.label: Manifest
decisions.reason: The sample satisfies every dry-run safety rule.

decisions.label: Write routes
decisions.reason: The first hosted slice remains read-only.

decisions.label: Endpoint
decisions.reason: Validation has no provider side effect.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, runtime, or credential is active.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: The claim contract does not authenticate a real reviewer.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: Ledger semantics are verified without a connected durable provider.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No invitation token, participant, or external session exists.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Implementation readiness cannot activate a public service.
